description: A painted dim interior with rough timber beams and a stone or plaster wall. About a dozen bearded men and veiled women in robes of red, maroon, navy, ochre and grey crowd together, all gazing upward. Small flames flicker on the walls and near a few heads, and a shaft of light falls from the upper left. An arched doorway sits in the background. The style is a dark, oil-painted realism with no visible text, frame or signature.
